study type: Clinical practice guideline / Review of existing literature supporting recommendations
cohort: The study discusses treatment for patients with localized pancreatic cancer, including those with unresectable, borderline, or resectable disease, specifically focusing on borderline-resectable cases.
finding: Intraoperative radiation therapy (IOERT) is a precise and effective treatment modality that improves local control and long-term survival in patients with pancreatic cancer when used as part of multimodal therapy.
